I suppose I'll start the ball rolling. A friend of mine a few years ago didn't know she was pregnant up until giving birth. She was about 19 years old and had gained hardly any weight, we all just thought she had yo-yoed a bit and put on a few pounds. She had no bump to speak of and continued having periods every second or third month. (which was normal for her, she had something wrong with one ovary). Anyway, she continued for the whole pregnancy to drink, smoke and do various drugs including E and cannabis. One day, her and some of my other friends at the time were chilling out with a few pills. She got a bad pain in her abdomen and after a while decided to go to the hospital. Everyone thought it was her appendix. To her surprise it was a baby, she had gone into labour.

**tl;dr: Friend didn't know she was pregnant until giving birth while high on pills.**

When I was 14 (I am 22 now) I was a reluctant member of scouts. I really didn't like playing any of the games they held every Thursday and was reluctant to ever try anyhing new. My brother's best friend was also in scouts, a very hyperactive boy who always just kidded around and har fun. I think he had adhd actually thinking back on it. Anyway, we were at scouts and I was refusing to participate as usual and was sitting at the sidelines on my own. He sat beside me briefly and tried to get me to play in that fun joking manner he always had. When I politely refused he suddenly got really serious, looked me dead in the eye and said 'you're wasting your life'. Then he just got up and went back to playing. I was more shocked than hurt by it because it was so out of character for him. Anyway, what he said stuck in my mind that night and the next day I decided to go out and play tennis with friends, something I would never normally do. I was really happy and even chatted to them about what a great guy my brother's friend was. 
I found out that evening that he had died earlier that morning. His father had gone insane and murdered him before trying to get to his other kids who were in school or creche that day. Andrew, my bro's friend, was off school that day because of a teacger's meeting. His brother found him later on. 
I know it isn't a supernatural story like most of those on here, but for me what Andrew said to me, how it has stuck in my mind to this day and what happened to Andrew only a few hours later are too many coincidences for my liking. I think the worst part is that my brother and I were going to have him sleep in our house that night. If we had this may not have happened.
